subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/stream` as a shared core session command with a plugin-facing `previewStreamingSessionOverride` capability for Telegram, Discord, and Slack now?
rationale: This adds durable session state plus a plugin capability contract; automation can repair the persistence bug but cannot decide the permanent command/API shape.

options.title: Accept after repair and proof
options.body: Keep the shared command/capability design, require the current-main persistence repair, and get live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the MVP
options.body: Limit the first landing to one channel or a smaller internal seam if maintainers are not ready to commit to a shared plugin capability.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the canonical issue open and close or defer the PR if the command surface is not product-approved yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the shared command/capability design, require the current-main persistence repair, and get live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history around preview-streaming helper ownership and is a plausible maintainer decision route for the shared command/capability boundary.
